entries.content: Single-file test loops in plugin/: `pnpm test -- src/foo.test.ts` behaved like a full-suite run (Temporal worker bundle builds, itest activity, 120s timeout), while `bin/oc-test targeted -- src/foo.test.ts` ran exactly one file in ~7s. Use `bin/oc-test targeted -- <file>` for tight iteration; reserve `pnpm test` for the full suite.
